case study · 01 / 05

SymptomScope AI

A health triage workflow that pairs an explainable prediction with a grounded assistant.

Next.jsFastAPIMongoDBscikit-learnLangChainChromaDB

Live project ↗　GitHub ↗

outcomes

3-model ensemble~89% prediction accuracy12 medical documents

problem

A symptom score needs to show how it reached its recommendation. A conversational layer also needs a boundary between useful guidance and a case that should be escalated.

architecture

decisions · why · trade-offs

Keep prediction and assistant as separate steps.

The ensemble produces a score while retrieval provides grounded context.

Trade-off accepted: The user moves through a more explicit workflow instead of receiving one opaque answer.

Expose SHAP explanations with the score.

A prediction is more useful when its contributing signals can be inspected.

Trade-off accepted: The explanation adds detail to the result view.

Retrieve from a bounded medical document set.

The assistant needs a defined source for its responses.

Trade-off accepted: Coverage stays limited to the indexed documents.

result

  • Combines a three-model ensemble, SHAP explanations, and a RAG assistant over 12 medical documents.
  • Includes authentication, history, dashboards, and PDF/CSV reporting.

if I kept going…

  • Evaluate escalation thresholds with clinical review.
  • Expand the retrieval corpus only with traceable sources.
